"""Centralized logging configuration for Chonkie.

This module provides a simple, extensible logging interface using Python's standard logging.
Logging defaults to WARNING level (shows warnings and errors) but can be customized via
the CHONKIE_LOG environment variable or programmatic API.

Environment Variable:
    CHONKIE_LOG: Control logging behavior
        - Not set: WARNING and above (default, shows warnings and errors)
        - off/false/0/disabled/none: Disable logging
        - error/1: ERROR level only
        - warning/2: WARNING and above (same as default)
        - info/3: INFO and above
        - debug/4: DEBUG and above (most verbose)

Example:
    >>> from chonkie.logger import get_logger
    >>> logger = get_logger(__name__)
    >>> logger.info("Processing chunks")

    >>> # Configure programmatically
    >>> import chonkie
    >>> chonkie.logger.configure("debug")
    >>> chonkie.logger.configure("off")  # Disable

"""

import os
import sys

github.description: 🦛 CHONK docs with Chonkie ✨ — The lightweight ingestion library for fast, efficient and robust RAG pipelines

summary.text: The repository is dominated by media files (72% of bytes) with the remaining code written entirely in Python (100% of code bytes). It provides a Python library for chunking text, exposing core types, logging, and embedding abstractions, and includes a FastAPI web API and CLI utilities.

scope.text: The codebase implements chunking algorithms, type definitions, logging, embedding base classes, a FastAPI API, CLI helpers, and extensive test suites covering chunkers and embeddings.

audience.text: Targeted at developers building RAG pipelines who need a lightweight, extensible chunking library and integrations with LLM APIs.

maturity.text: The project has active history, many contributors, extensive tests (94 test files, 0.75 test/source ratio), CI, Dockerfile, and a documented README, indicating a usable library ready for integration.

how_to_run.text: Install via pip (as shown in the README) and run the FastAPI server with the entry point src/chonkie/api/main.py or use the CLI utilities in src/chonkie/cli/cli_utils.py.

learning_path.text: Study the core type definitions (Chunk, Document, Sentence, etc.) which are heavily imported (88 modules) and form the basis of the chunking API.
Examine the centralized logging configuration to understand how the library manages log levels via environment variables.
Review the abstract BaseEmbeddings class to see how different embedding providers are integrated.
Look at the FastAPI entry point to learn how the library exposes its functionality as a web API.

caveats.text: No environment template is provided, so developers must create their own .env files for configuration.
While dependencies are locked, the pinned ratio is 0.0, indicating version ranges may be used.
